# GitHub Copilot project instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), the [assessment-only checklist](../docs/specifications/assessment-scope.md), and the [source-backed specification register](../docs/specifications/README.md) before suggesting MPEG frame/parser or HTTP changes. The linked topic documents define MPEG-1 Layer III bitfields/free-format, ID3 and encoder metadata, MIME/upload semantics, and supported/out-of-scope cases.

Do not assume all `.mp3` files are one bitrate/index; **free-format index 0 is supported** with bounded inference, MPEG-2/2.5 and other Layers are out of scope. Do not use an NPM MP3 frame parser or decoder for the implementation. Count _complete physical MPEG frames_ by default, not ID3 records; optional `includeVbrHeaderFrame=false` excludes only a recognized initial metadata frame. The evaluator's 6090/6089 sample convention is unresolved; see [`frame-count-contract.md`](../docs/frame-count-contract.md). Preserve streaming, limits and deterministic errors.
